name: Yield & Dynamic Pricing Sentinel
tagline: Autonomous price elasticity modeling and competitor inventory scraping.
shortDescription: Calculates optimal per-unit rates daily based on regional demand surges, vacancy velocity, seasonal patterns, and competitor pricing.
capabilities: Continuous regional competitor inventory & rate crawling
Dynamic surge premiums for high-occupancy categories (>90%)
Automated discount pacing for aged vacant units
Multi-channel rate distribution (Website, Aggregators, Direct)
simulationPrompt: Unit Type: 10x15 Climate Controlled Storage. Current Occupancy: 94%. Local Competitor Radius: 3 miles (All Sold Out). Target: Maximize Revenue while preserving 92% floor.
simulationResult: Recommendation: Elevate baseline daily rental rate from $145/mo to $168/mo (+15.8%). Expected booking probability: 88.4%. Projected extra monthly yield: +$4,600 across remaining tier units.

name: Predictive Occupancy & Churn Forecaster
tagline: Forecasts vacancies 30 to 90 days out with customer churn risk flags.
shortDescription: Analyzes payment delays, tenant portal logins, seasonality, and lease expirations to flag early risk of non-renewal.
capabilities: Early warning churn scoring for corporate & retail tenants
30/60/90-day probabilistic occupancy trajectory graph
Automated proactive lease renewal incentives sent via WhatsApp
Regional demographic and relocation trend ingestion
simulationPrompt: Tenant: Logistics Partner Corp. Lease Expiry: 45 Days. Payment Behavior: 12-day delay on last 2 invoices. Portal Activity: Zero logins in 30 days.
simulationResult: Churn Probability: 78.5% (High Risk). Trigger: Auto-dispatch account manager retention alert with custom 12-month extension discount incentive.

name: IoT Telematics & Predictive Maintenance Bot
tagline: Hardware telemetry ingestion and auto-dispatch to contractor networks.
shortDescription: Ingests smart lock battery telemetry, HVAC climate logs, and heavy machinery engine hours to prevent failure before it happens.
capabilities: CAN-bus & IoT sensor real-time telemetry stream parsing
Automated work order creation with priority classification
Vendor SLA tracking and digital job sign-off verification
Predictive component failure alerts before breakdown
simulationPrompt: Telemetry Alert: Scissor Lift #SL-402 recorded 260 operating hours. Hydraulic pressure sensor jitter detected at 15% deviation above normal operating threshold.
simulationResult: Action: Unit reservation locked on calendar. P1 Work Order dispatched to Certified Field Technician. Preventive seal replacement scheduled before site dispatch.

name: Multilingual AI Renter Concierge & Booking Agent
tagline: Automates self-service tours, lease queries, gate access, and bill disputes.
shortDescription: Acts as a virtual facility manager answering customer questions on WhatsApp, Web, and SMS 24/7 with zero human intervention required.
capabilities: Natural conversational booking and digital KYC guidance
Instant gate code & PIN troubleshooting assistance
Payment method updates and receipt re-issuance
Multi-language translation in 32+ global languages
simulationPrompt: Customer Message (WhatsApp): 'Hi, I'm standing outside Unit #204 at Apex Storage and forgot my keypad code. My phone number is 512-555-0192.'
simulationResult: Verification: Tenant verified via two-factor OTP. Response: 'Hello Sarah, your one-time entry PIN is #8492. Gate lock unlocked for the next 15 minutes.'

name: Payment Risk & Smart Dunning Sentinel
tagline: Predicts default risk and triggers intelligent dynamic recovery sequences.
shortDescription: Calculates payment failure probabilities and initiates personalized payment schedules, automated grace periods, or partial payment recovery.
capabilities: Pre-due-date risk scoring based on bank debit indicators
Intelligent dunning sequence timing (SMS, WhatsApp, Email)
Automated overlock / gate restriction rule enforcement
Settlement & payment plan generator for overdue balances
simulationPrompt: Account Balance: $320 Overdue (10 days). Card Decline Code: Insufficient Funds. Past history: 6 on-time payments, 1 late payment.
simulationResult: Action: Trigger Stage 2 Gentle Recovery Sequence. Send WhatsApp link offering two-split installment plan. Lock gate access only if unaddressed after Day 14.
